subject: FoodTech POS v4.2.3 update stuck at 67% installation; terminal unresponsive
description: ServeWell - Paschim Vihar POS Terminal 1 (asset POS-0110-T1) began a software update to FoodTech POS v4.2.3 at approximately 09:15 IST this morning. The update progress bar has been frozen at 67% for over 1 hour. The terminal display shows 'Installing core modules...' but no further progress is evident. The terminal is completely unresponsive to touch input and keyboard commands. We have attempted a soft restart by waiting 15 minutes without power-off, but the update process resumed at the same 67% position. A hard power restart was avoided to prevent data corruption during the update cycle. The store is operating on a secondary POS terminal (POS-0110-T2) but is experiencing reduced checkout capacity during peak lunch service hours (11:00-14:00). This is impacting customer throughput and creating queues at the counter. Estimated business impact: 15-20% reduction in transaction processing speed during peak hours.

ticket_history.note: Ticket acknowledged. Remote diagnostics initiated to verify update process status and identify any network/connectivity issues affecting the installation.
Confirmed update process is hung; reboot of terminal recommended to clear stuck installation. Escalation to L2 technical team being prepared for manual update recovery if soft reset fails.
